next.reason: 1985: "When the I-O phrase is specified and the LABEL RECORDS clause indicates label records are present... labels are checked"; 2023: "OPEN rules (e.g. GR-14.9.27.4-16 on the I-O phrase) state no label checking or writing; no candidate mentions LABEL RECORDS". 2023 OPEN rules cover the I-O phrase but say nothing of label records or label checking and writing. The LABEL RECORDS feature is absent from the candidates, so the requirement is dropped.
